docs: ### Toggle A two-state button component that can be toggled on or off for formatting controls, filters, and feature toggles. **Import Path**: ```typescript import { Toggle } from "@/components/ui/toggle/toggle"; ``` #### Default Standard pressable toggle button. ```tsx const [isBold, setIsBold] = React.useState(true); Bold ``` #### Sizes Scale toggle dimensions: 'sm', 'md', or 'lg'. ```tsx Small Medium Large ``` #### Variants (Default, Outline, Flat) Visual style options: 'default', 'outline', or 'flat'. ```tsx Default Outline Flat ``` #### Props — Toggle Supported properties for Toggle. | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | pressed / defaultPressed | boolean | false | Controlled / uncontrolled pressed toggle state. | | variant | 'default' | 'outline' | 'flat' | 'default' | Visual button border & background style. | | size | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'md' | Dimension scale of toggle button. |
